title: import_data_taxonomy input
description: Turns a CSV, or the rows of a Fabric or Purview domain list, into a configuration draft of business data domains (docs/architecture/data-taxonomy.md). The caller passes the content: the product holds no Fabric or Purview permission. Owners in the file become prepared owner changes, never live owners. Nothing is in force until a person accepts the draft.

csv.description: The CSV text: a header row with the columns key, label, parent, level, classification, description, examples, use_rule, ai_rule, copy_rule, retention, match_vocabulary, match_term, match_url, owner, deputy, steward, then one domain per row. label is required.

rows.description: The same rows as objects, such as an AI client builds from a Fabric or Purview domain list.

source.description: Where the list came from. It names the outside vocabulary a match_term without match_vocabulary belongs to.

baseVersionNumber.description: The configuration version the import is read against. Defaults to the version in force.

examples.proposalRationale: Load the HR domain list agreed with the data governance lead
